# CODER 9 — Session 2: full reconstruction + re-verification · ALL achievements now on GitHub

**Context.** The session-1 sandbox was recycled and the local working tree (base `25b5a01` + patch #1 + harness) was lost with it. This session recovered patch #1 from comment 1 of this Issue, **reconstructed both law tests and the entire §5 synthetic harness from the documented contracts**, and re-verified every claim from scratch at base `25b5a01` + patch #1. Nothing below is carried over on trust — every number was re-produced this session.

## Artifacts (patch #2, previous comment — 10 files, 1295 lines, text-only)

- `tests/c9_zip_data_offset_law_test.cpp` — 42 laws, 7 families: plain STORED · **LFH-extra≠CDE-extra discriminator** · multi-entry mixed · data-descriptor (bit-3 streaming) · prepended stub · hostile archives (corrupt LFH sig / OOB offset / compressed-size lie / zero-length) · integration identities incl. the `lfh+30+name+extra` formula re-derived from raw file bytes.
- `tests/c9_bitmap_density_law_test.cpp` — 36 laws: degenerate inputs · inSampleSize clamp/ceil · all four scale gates · scale arithmetic (round-half-up constants) · sample×density composition · recorded clamp-to-1 divergence · `setDensityFromOptions` marking.
- `tests/fixtures/c9_resources/` — manifest + `MainActivity` (14 CASE lines) + res XMLs (vector 48dp, en/fa strings).
- `scripts/c9/gen_c9_fixture_assets.py` — deterministic binary assets (PNGs per density bucket, lossless WebP, invalid image, nested/compressed/stored assets, DejaVu font copy). Regenerates byte-identical outputs; keeps binaries out of the patch.
- `scripts/c9/postprocess_c9_fixture.py` — pins `assets/c9_stored.bin` STORED + `assets/c9_compressed.txt` DEFLATE, 1980 epoch, prints independent APPNOTE §4.3.7 data offsets + SHA-256s.
- `scripts/c9/validate_c9_resources.sh` — the one-command harness: build → post-process → 4 engine runs → 41 law assertions → evidence dir.

## Verification matrix (this session, fresh)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| Engine build (`make -j all`) at `25b5a01` + patch #1 | OK |
| C9-2 zip data-offset law test | **42/42** |
| C9-1 bitmap density law test | **36/36** |
| `resource_config_selection_test` | **48/48** |
| `resource_core_law_test` | **42/42** |
| `resource_hostile_test` | **18/18** |
| §5/§6 harness `validate_c9_resources.sh` | **41/41** |

One-command reproduction (toolchain present; see recovery note below):
```
bash scripts/c9/validate_c9_resources.sh /tmp/c9_evidence
```

## Provenance & identity (deterministic fixture)

- Fixture APK `84017f3ef4d22cd67ef478a09e2509c36418c2c6558b778ed9de5d5157fa1398` (774,735 bytes; byte-deterministic across rebuilds).
- `assets/c9_stored.bin` STORED `data_offset=13824 csize=115 sha256=45a3984527b4e26e85b39b45e8617c7d45b4000cad4d68574f80ecd5831ca872` — engine `CASE05 afd startOffset=13824 length=115 declared=115 openBytes=115 stream==open=true` in **all four runs**; independent python re-read of the fd window == zipfile extraction (two read paths agree, byte-level).
- `assets/c9_compressed.txt` DEFLATE (`csize=17`): `open` serves 2000 bytes, `openFd` → `FileNotFoundException` in all runs.
- Nested asset head `43392d4e45535445` — byte-identical to the session-1 documented head (generator constants preserved).
- CASE01 `105x53` @420 · `40x20` @160 · `60x30` @240; CASE02 bounds `24x12` mime `image/webp` → full `63x32`; CASE06 intrinsics `126x126`/`72x72`/`48x48` (C9-3 tracks density); CASE08 `Hello C9` / `سلام کد۹`; CASE10-12 `decode_null=true` / `NotFoundException` / `invalid_null=true` (no fake pixels); CASE13 nodpi `40x20` unscaled at 420/160/240.
- §6 pixel law: @160 **RED=1953, GREEN=0**; @240 **GREEN=1953, RED=0**; @420 **GREEN=2016, RED=0**; blue vector ≈3081-3087 px and amber triangle ≈882-888 px in **every** run. Screenshot SHA-256s (4 distinct — bucket selection moves the framebuffer): 420/en `b5e50782e54496ad…`, 160/en `69f885e98ed3254e…`, 240/en `04c3734c7d5dee87…`, 420/fa `74c0e040482bdd7a…`.

## Toolchain recovery note (reproducibility)

`repo1.maven.org` (and its `repo.maven.apache.org` mirror) rate-limited this sandbox (HTTP 429), and the Eclipse archive paths 404'd. Bootstrap was completed from hash-verifiable alternates: **aapt2 8.13.2-14304508** and **r8 8.13.23** from `dl.google.com` (the bootstrap's own pinned coordinates), **ECJ 3.33.0** (exact pinned version) from Google's Maven Central mirror `maven-central.storage-download.googleapis.com`, and **android-all-14** Robolectric stubs (137,666,235 B, `PK` header verified) from the same mirror. Adding this mirror fallback to `bootstrap_toolchain.sh` is a generic infra hardening — offered as follow-up work if approved.

## NEW [OBSERVED] divergence registered (generic; no app-specific branch)

`Resources.getDisplayMetrics().densityDpi` answers the runtime default (420) even when `MINIANDROID_DENSITY` selects a different bucket, while resource **bucket selection** and **C9-3 vector intrinsics** track the requested density correctly (proven by CASE01/06/07 and the pixel law). The DisplayMetrics shadow is not fed from `device_config()` — a small generic law for a future C9 phase (PENDING). No behavior above depends on it.

## Status

- ACH-1 (C9-1 density law), ACH-2 (C9-2 AFD data-offset law), ACH-3 (C9-3 vector intrinsic law): **[IMPLEMENTED] [TESTED]** — re-verified this session.
- §5 synthetic harness + §6 pixel law: **[IMPLEMENTED] [TESTED] 41/41** (reconstructed; now also fully ON GitHub as patch #2).
- The body's "known limitations / next steps" list (1-6) stands unchanged, PENDING.
- Recorded divergences unchanged: degenerate clamp-to-1, nearest-neighbour resample, `Bitmap.compress` unsupported.

## Security / channel note

Token used env-var only; never printed, committed or embedded. The supplied PAT holds **Contents: read only** (branch push → HTTP 403), so the standing agreement holds: this Issue remains the complete work record. Local branch `coder9/c9-resource-laws` (2 commits on `25b5a01`: patch #1 applied, patch #2 added) can be pushed the moment the token gains Contents:write, or cherry-picked by the manager directly from comments 1 and 2 — both patches round-trip verified on a fresh `25b5a01` worktree this session.
